items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I remember one thing that caught me was a violin solo, (?) Meditation, I think by Massenet.

ctx.x: Was there music in your home?

My mother used to fool with the guitar, and my uncle played Blues on the guitar and sing the Blues. But my earliest recollection of hearing sound was an old Victrola or gramophone, whichever it was called, and this particular piece sticks in my mind. They had a lot of Bert Williams records and Paul Whiteman records. And I remember one thing that caught me was a violin solo, (?) Meditation, I think by Massenet.
